description: This file defines an abstract class IdTypeResolver in Java, providing functionality to resolve and format ID types, including an enumeration for different ID types.

classes.name: IdTypeResolver
classes.description: An abstract class for resolving ID types with nested enum IdType that implements DefaultOption.

classes.name: IdType
classes.description: An enum representing different types of IDs, with methods to check default status.

methods.name: resolveDefault
methods.description: Returns the default ID type, which is ID.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves an ID type string into an enum of type IdType or other enum classes.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Generic method to resolve an ID type string into an enum constant of the specified class.

methods.name: formatIdType
methods.description: Formats the ID type string by replacing hyphens with underscores and converting to uppercase.

methods.name: resolveFailed
methods.description: Creates a PlatformApiDataValidationException when resolving an ID type fails.
